description: This file defines the AlertCommand class for executing and validating alert SQL queries within the Superset project, including handling query execution, validation, and alert triggering logic.

classes.name: AlertCommand
classes.description: Class responsible for executing alert SQL queries, validating results, and determining if alert conditions are met within the Superset alerting system.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the alert query, validates the result, updates report schedule, and determines if alert is triggered.

methods.name: _validate_not_null
methods.description: Validates that the query result is not null and sets internal result state.

methods.name: _validate_result
methods.description: Checks if the query returned more than one row or column and raises errors if so.

methods.name: _validate_operator
methods.description: Validates the query result against an operator and threshold.

methods.name: _is_validator_not_null
methods.description: Property indicating if the validator type is NOT_NULL.

methods.name: _is_validator_operator
methods.description: Property indicating if the validator type is OPERATOR.

methods.name: _execute_query
methods.description: Executes the alert SQL query, applying limits and handling exceptions.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the query by executing it and processing the DataFrame result.
